Strength +4: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +4 Enhancement bonus to Strength.
Speed +16%: +16% enhancement bonus to movement speed, 5% bonus to attack speed.
Mythic Neck Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
